name: social-unsch
description: Monorepo de SOCIAL-UNSCH: aplicación web (apps/web) y API (apps/api)

scripts.build:all: npm run build:api && npm run build:radar && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @social-unsch/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @social-unsch/api && npm run typecheck -w @social-unsch/radar && npm run typecheck -w @social-unsch/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @social-unsch/api && npm test -w @social-unsch/radar && npm test -w @social-unsch/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @social-unsch/api && npm run test:coverage -w @social-unsch/radar
scripts.verify: npm run check:boundaries && npm run test:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:web && npm run build:all
